title: 118 2.2.2 There was a steady increase in the number of towns till 1951 but due to defined standards applied in 1961 to determine whether a place qualified to be treated as an Urban centre or not, many urban centres were declassified and hence, the number declined from 2,843 in 1951 to 2,365 in 1961. According to the latest census (1991), the number of such towns have risen up to 3,768 (an increase of 59.3% over 1961). 2.2.3 As per Section 8(1) of the Cr.PC, the State Governments have the power to declare, by notification, any area in the state comprising a city or a town whose population exceeds one million (10 lakhs), as a metropolitan area.
